snippet.title: Coloco - RZX Playback
snippet.description:
Coloco
2020 - Tuxedo Games (Spain)
ZX-Spectrum 48K - Arcade Game: Action

Recorded by Daren (with rollback) 

More info here: https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/36342/ZX-Spectrum/Coloco

We are most grateful to the late Daren Pearcy for all his work in popularising the RZX format. Without his work this project would not have been possible.
